about_the_game:
Add-on for Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii that allows you to change into two of Ichiban Kasuga's iconic outfits.

■ ICHIBAN SPECIAL OUTFIT SET

- Special Outfit: Ichiban Kasuga (Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth)

- Special Outfit: Ichiban Kasuga (Yakuza: Like a Dragon)

*The “Ichiban Special Outfit Set” will be available after the ability to change outfits is unlocked in Chapter 2 of the main game.

*The contents of the "Ichiban Special Outfit Set" will not be counted toward in-game achievements.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Blood, Intense Violence, Sexual Themes, Strong Language, and Use of Tobacco and Alcohol.
